levels.title: A  L I F E
levels.subtitle: BALL / BOOK / SKATEBOARD / LAPTOP / MOUSE / UMBRELLA
levels.intro: Six things from one life. Turn them in the light until their shadows stand up as one person.
levels.hint: Start with the head. The umbrella becomes something to lean on. Seen from the side, an open laptop bends like an elbow.
levels.complete:
A LIFE
The ball he chased, the books he carried, the board he rode, the work he did -
all of it, still holding him up.

levels.title: I T A L I A
levels.subtitle: PARMIGIANO / TOWER / OLIVE OIL / PEPERONCINO / PIZZA / POMODORI
levels.intro: Six souvenirs of one country. Fill the map with their shadows.
levels.hint: The tower leans down the peninsula. The chili is the toe, the bottle the heel, and a slice of pizza is an island.
levels.complete:
ITALIA
Cheese in the north, a leaning tower down the middle,
peperoncino in the toe and pizza by the sea.

levels.title: N I P P O N
levels.subtitle: ONIGIRI / KOKESHI / DARUMA / SHINKANSEN / UDON / MANEKI-NEKO
levels.intro: Six things from one country, one for each part of the islands. Fill the map with their shadows.
levels.hint: The rice ball is the north island. The bullet train runs west along the coast; the lucky cat waves from the south-west.
levels.complete:
NIPPON
Rice in the north, dolls and trains through the middle,
a bowl of udon and a waving cat in the south.
